value.a: PROXIMITY, NOT COMPUTATION TIME, is the coarseness axis — Akien's correction, verbatim: 'not computation time as in your example. it'd be more like how deep we have to look. is it a file lookup? is it a value in a file? is it a value i have to compute from multiple local sources? do i need the web? --- more related to proximity?' CC had proposed cost, which comes apart from coarseness in software: a coarse check can walk the whole repo and a fine one can be a regex on a line. Proximity is a property of the sieve; cost is a property of the run.

MESH-AS-PHRASING vs MESH-AS-BAND are two things wearing one word, and Akien drew the line the same day. 'Ask the finest requirement possible' — his example: ask whether a keyword is available, not what Python version is running — is about how a sieve is PHRASED. The band is about how far it must REACH. Merging them is the failure this distinction is filed against.

FOUR BANDS, BOUNDARIES WHERE THE FAILURE MODE CHANGES, not where the milliseconds change: input-in-hand (cannot fail environmentally) / local disk (fails on absence) / correlated local work — several files, git plumbing, an AST walk — (fails on inconsistency) / off-box — db, inference host, network — (fails on UNAVAILABILITY, which nothing above it can do). That last boundary earns its keep: an unreachable host must never be able to mask a local finding. THE COUNT IS A FIRST CUT given at Akien's explicit request for CC's experience, and it is a hypothesis (Law 3) until the sorting pass runs.

BANDS, NOT STRICT NUMBERING — rejected on ownership, not taste: inserting a sieve between 2 and 3 forces fractional numbers or renumbering, and renumbering is a WRITE TO OTHER SIEVES (Law 6). With bands a new sieve declares its own and the nest reassembles; nothing existing is touched. Within a band, order genuinely does not matter, which is what lets a band be shaken at once.

THE SIEVE KNOWS NOTHING ABOUT THE NEST and the nest reads nothing but the sieve's own code — Akien named the payoff: 'it's a charactaristic of the kind of thing it's doing rather than where it's doing it. greater reusability.' There is no configuration surface between sieve and assembly at all, so the same sieve dropped into another nest self-places.

CC REIFIED AN EXAMPLE, caught by Akien at n=1 in the same conversation: his mesh illustration (exists -> non-empty -> valid JSON -> field present -> in range) was shipped by CC as a five-tier taxonomy and a definition of coarseness. 'that was an example, not a definition of truth.' Same tell as the trigger-kinds enum and the rack — a list of instances turned into a closed set.

A BAND SEQUENCES, IT NEVER FORBIDS — Akien's correction 2026-08-06, and it is the second time in one day CC wrote a current state as a law. The band exists so that a distant sieve runs LAST and an unreachable host cannot mask a local finding; it does not exist to red a sieve for reaching. An EMPTY band is empty, not closed. The distinguisher, from the same day's self-inspection ruling: does this describe how the world must be, or what we have not built yet?

A FINDING CARRIES A DATUM AND A SCORE — Akien, 2026-08-06, closing the shape: 'each finding can have a datum AND a score. because the score is relative to the requirement.' That sentence is why the float is worth having and why it is not ambiguous: a bare number would be a reading, not a verdict, and the mesh is what makes it a verdict. It also places the learnable value exactly where the design already wanted it — the mesh is the number a block can move on feedback (learns-its-gates), and the score is the measurement it moves against. BINARY TODAY BY MEASUREMENT, NOT BY LAW: every check build_inspector runs is binary as of now, so every score is 1.0 or 0.0 and every mesh is `>= 1`. His stated expiry — 'this may change later based on things like elapsed time or performacne values' — so the float is forward-shape for a named future, not speculative generality. Recorded this way deliberately: a CURRENT LIMITATION written as a limitation, never as a rule, which is the correction he made on this same day about self-inspection.

THE TWO KINDS OF STACK ARE THE EVALUATION LOOP AND THE DECIDE STEP, and both are already built. Akien recalled that the filter era had two kinds of stack — 'one that would let one answer thru and one that would let a set of answers thru.' They are not two nest types: a nest shakes a SET of candidates through an ORDERED set of sieves, so 'a set through' is the survivors of the evaluation loop, and 'one through' is cairn/machines/learning_block/engine.py:175's DECIDE OR ESCALATE, which ranks survivors by the spec's order and picks one. THE VECTOR AND THE FILE-LIST ARE TWO MARGINALS OF ONE TABLE: roll up along the candidate axis and you get his [1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0] = 0.0; roll up along the sieve axis and you get what each mesh caught, which is the 'list a file for each finding' shape. build_inspector is already the many-candidates case — components are the candidates, checks are the sieves — and the single-component vector is one slice of it. CC's read, not Akien's ruling, but it describes code that exists rather than proposing a mechanism.

THE ROLL-UP RULE IS THE FRAGILE PART, not the vector. Rolling a candidate's scores up with AND treats every sieve as must-pass, which is correct for a checklist gate and is what build_inspector is. The first ADVISORY sieve — one whose failure should inform without condemning — breaks the roll-up rule and nothing else. Named here so that when it arrives it is recognised as a rule change rather than patched as a special case.

THE RENAME IS OUT OF BOUNDS. decisions/2026-08-06-a-stack-of-sieves-is-a-nest also renames filter->sieve corpus-wide and carries its own sequencing clause — before or after nothing-rides-loose, never during. This node uses the vocabulary and performs no rename; a child that quietly does so is out of bounds.

THE BANDS ARE REPLACED, AND THE OLD ONES ARE SUPERSEDED NOT DELETED (Akien, 2026-08-12, ruled). The reach/proximity ladder — distinctions 1 and 3 in this very list, and BAND_NAMES today — was scaffolding standing in the seat of the real answer, exactly as its own note said ('kept by leave to remain and not to be grown'). His words: 'each question is a seive. and because we might have seives that come after others (which is min, which is max) this is the kind of bands that we replace our previous ideas with: preprocessing, recording, postprocessing. and the which is smallest is simply a post processing seive.' So the band axis stops being HOW FAR A SIEVE LOOKS and becomes WHEN IT CAN RUN. Distinctions 1 and 3 remain true about the thing they described and are no longer the spec; read them as history.

ONE VERB, NOT TWO — and this is what the band change buys. CC had reduced the engine to compare-after-running plus find-me-the-smallest/largest, citing cairn/tools/base/nest.py::shake as already being both (scores[name] = 0.0 if caught else 1.0 is the compare; the min() roll-up is the extremum). Akien collapsed it further: the extremum is not engine machinery, it is A SIEVE THAT RUNS LATE. min() therefore leaves the roll-up and joins the corpus, where it is inspectable, replaceable, and can be WRONG like any other sieve. Gate-mode (min) and select-mode (max) become two members rather than two modes.

THE BAND STAYS DERIVED, NEVER AUTHORED — checked explicitly before ruling, because the old derivation (import_sieve.reach_of over the sieve's own body) was about to stop applying and an authored label would have been a silent regression: the first sieve mislabelled runs in the wrong order with nothing to catch it. THE TELL, proposed by CC and ruled to hold: WHAT THE SIEVE READS. A recording sieve takes the SUBJECT; a postprocessing sieve takes the PRIOR STAMPS; preprocessing produces the subjects rather than scoring them. Different input, visible in the body, same AST derivation already built. Akien: 'that holds.'

A FINDING IS A STAMPED CONDITION, AND THE TICKET IS THE PIPELINE (Akien, 2026-08-12, verbatim): 'build inspector: {test 1: true, test 2: true} is pretty much the same as {result 1: foo, result 2: bar} but we could make the data even smarter... this is back to how tickets work AS THE PIPELINE: {test 1: {about: checks for x, expected: true, actual: true}, test 2: {about: checks for y, expected: true, actual: false} because you can put EVERYTHING you need into that. you could even add another field for the kind of compare. exact match, substring, etc. and even what the method to call is. all that gets stamped at the start of the mesh on the findings ticket at the start, and then each seive stamps it as it goes by.' This SUPERSEDES the intention field's 'A FINDING CARRIES A DATUM AND A SCORE' — same seat, and now with everything needed in it. Scoring is not a third operation: the compare field absorbs it (exact/substring emit a bool, similarity emits a float). Gate-mode vs select-mode is distinguished by the PRESENCE OF expected, which is data too. FALSIFIER, and it is the ticket's own WATCHME(engine-branchless-under-a-second-block) restated: if telling the two modes apart ever needs an `if` in the engine, the data is not smart enough yet.

THERE IS NO IMMEASURABLE ANYTHING INSIDE THE SYSTEM. AKIEN IS FOR NOW PART OF THE SYSTEM. (Akien, 2026-08-12, broadening his own ruling the moment he read CC's record of it.) THE FIRST RECORDING WAS NARROWER AND IS KEPT HERE AS THE ERROR IT WAS: CC wrote it as 'there is no unmeasurable CLASS', and 'class' was itself the defect — in Cairn the word already means node_class, class-space, a type at birth, so recording the ruling in that vocabulary re-committed the exact move the ruling was correcting. A class is a bin you could put things in; his statement is that no such bin can exist ANYWHERE inside the system — not a sentence, not a bullet, not a component, not a decision, not a person. Not 'every sieve emits' scoped to sieves: nothing inside is out of reach of measurement, and 'I can't measure that' is always a statement about the instrument, never about the thing. HOW IT CAME UP: sorting the 392 bullets standing behind the 104 gate findings, CC split them into 'measurements in costume' and a second half it called judgment/provenance/interpretation, then asked Akien to rule on where the second half should be filed. All three 'unmeasurable' examples converted to {about, expected, actual, method} in one line each. THE MECHANISM WORTH KEEPING: prose in a finding is a claim hedged out of falsifiability — a wrong measurement has an `actual` to be wrong about and is a training pair; narration has neither. AND THE HALF THAT WOULD OTHERWISE GET DROPPED — 'akien is for now part of the system' is the load-bearing clause, not a courtesy. It puts HIM inside the measured set: his gate depth (104), his approve/disprove/question split, his latency, the 'times Akien re-ordered the gathers' denominator his own /whatslefttodo charter already names. Some of that is already measured and read as being about the QUEUE; it is equally about him, and saying so is the point. IT IS A LAW, AND HE STATED IT AS ONE (Akien, 2026-08-12, verbatim): 'let me state this clearly as a physical law within the whole system: Nothing in the system, and by the system now I mean this laptop, including our project, EXCEPT CLAUDE (for now), has anything in it that can't be measured. There are many things we haven't built measurment for yet, but our ground most assumption is: we can know everything about this system. When we get as far as igor's deep reasoning that may change. i hope not. but for now, there is nothing you can name on this laptop or the things connected to it that I can't sort a way to measure. Even you. Give me another year, and I will know how you work well enough to copy it. We're already well along the way. And that is the single hardest thing in the system to externalize. So for all practical purposes, nothing in our system can't be measured. if you can't figure out a way, escalate the problem to me.' LANDED AS CLAUDE.md LAW 10. FOUR THINGS THE PRIOR ENTRY GOT WRONG OR MISSED, corrected here rather than edited away: (1) THE EXCEPTION IS CLAUDE, NOT NOBODY — CC recorded 'no immeasurable anything' with no exception at all; there is exactly one, it is Claude, and it is temporary and shrinking ('give me another year... we're already well along the way'). (2) CC glossed the 'for now' as marking AKIEN'S MEMBERSHIP as transitional. Wrong party. His membership is not what ends; the CLAUDE EXCEPTION is. (3) THE SCOPE IS PHYSICAL, not conceptual: this laptop, our project inside it, and the things connected to it — a bounded machine, which is what makes the claim checkable rather than a slogan. (4) THE DISTINCTION THE LAW IS MADE OF, and CC's original defect stated exactly: 'there are many things we haven't built measurment for yet' is a TRUE and ordinary state; 'this cannot be measured' is a claim about the world and is false inside this system. Collapsing the first into the second is how a claim stops being falsifiable. THE OPERATIVE CLAUSE: 'if you can't figure out a way, escalate the problem to me.' Immeasurable is never a resting state and never a filing — it is an escalation, and the escalation is to him. That joins the standing two-dispositions rule (fix it now, or a ticket) with the third door for this one case. HIS OWN HORIZON ON IT: 'when we get as far as igor's deep reasoning that may change. i hope not.' Recorded as his, unhedged — the law is asserted with its own expiry condition named, which is the shape Law 3 asks of every claim.

'EVERY RECORDED OBSERVATION IS MEASURMENT' (Akien, 2026-08-12, verbatim) — the operational definition, and the one that makes Law 10 usable instead of a demand for apparatus. THE BAR IS NOT AN INSTRUMENT: you looked, you wrote down what you saw, that is a measurement at n=1. 'the grep returned nothing' is one. 'Akien said X' is one. A charter's own sentence about itself is one. THIS IS WHAT DISSOLVES CC'S ORIGINAL ERROR COMPLETELY, and it is worth stating because the two earlier corrections had not: the 392 findings were never unmeasurable and were never even un-measured — they were 392 measurements ALREADY TAKEN, then written up as narration instead of recorded in a shape that could be wrong. Nothing had to be gone and got. CC had silently raised the bar from 'observed and recorded' to 'produced by an instrument I could point at', and then filed everything below that invented bar as a different kind of thing. IT ALSO REFRAMES THE RECORD SHAPE THIS TICKET IS ABOUT: {about, expected, actual, compare, method} is not a burden imposed on findings, it is the FIELDS an already-existing measurement was missing. The sieve does not create the measurement; it gives one a place to be wrong in. AND IT SETTLES THE 'NOT BUILT YET' CLAUSE OF LAW 10: an unbuilt instrument does not leave you with nothing, it leaves you with a COARSE measurement to sharpen. Which is the same shape as everything else here — coarse-first, sharpened against need, never absent.

AND THE LEVELS ARE DETERMINISTIC CODE DRIVEN BY CONFIG DATA (Akien, 2026-08-12, verbatim, ~17:25 — the clause that arrived after the 14:48 ruling above and belongs beside it): 'mesh levels are now preprocess, record and postprocess, in deterministic code driven by config data.' TWO THINGS RIDE THIS AND NEITHER IS SETTLED. First, DETERMINISTIC: no inference anywhere in the level assignment or the ordering — the same nest assembles the same way every time, which is what makes a wrongly-ordered sieve a reproducible red rather than a flake. Second, CONFIG DATA: the levels are DATA the assembly reads, not a taxonomy compiled into the vocabulary — which is what the killed 'make a band into stored data' ticket was reaching at from the wrong end, back when a band was proximity. WHERE that config berths, and whether it REPLACES the AST derivation (import_sieve.reach_of) or FEEDS it, is UNRULED and is the first question this ticket's build must chart — the derivation-stays-derived rule above and 'driven by config data' are not obviously the same thing, and CC should not pick between them alone.
